Every current Package manifest MUST be an object with `format: "snl-package"`, storage `version: 1`, `schema_version: 2`, string `id`, `name`, and `description`, and present `entry_ids`.

Its filename MUST equal the deterministic hash-derived path for its ID. Package IDs MUST satisfy the Extension grammar and Windows-device-name restriction. Identities MUST be unique under case-folding. `entry_ids` MUST be sorted by locale-independent UTF-16 code-unit order, duplicate-free, and contain only non-empty whitespace-canonical strings. A manifest for `_unpackaged` MUST exist.
